'''Grommik Kurthson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], working as a security officer for the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] prior to the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Grommik Kurthson was born about 50 years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].<ref name="Last One Out" />
[[File:Grommik_Young.png|thumb|left|120px|A holorecording of Kurthson during his work at Czerka]]
Decades before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Grommik was a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] corporation security guard at their [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|secret research base]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The base was constructed around an ancient Rakatan cave, and its mission was the study of artifacts hidden within.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]|The Thing Czerka Found|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

One of the artifacts - a [[mind prison]] containing the consciousness of a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] known as [[the Imprisoned One]] - got activated, and the Imprisoned One turned most of the personnel in the base into his mindless puppets. [[Yem Antayen]], director of the base, initiated a lock down, ordering Grommik and other surviving personnel to seal the facility.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" /> As the last man out, Grommik personally sealed the door leaving several Czerka workers still inside, including his close friend [[Wallner]].<ref name="Last One Out" /> Grommik left behind a holorecording to warn anyone who finds it to stay away from the base.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" /> The only survivor of the incident, he set up a [[Grommik's Residence|moisture farm]] on Tatooine and lived an isolated life for years.<ref name="Last One Out" />

In [[3643 BBY]] Grommik noticed that his farm's [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|vaporators]], [[Perimeter sensor/Legends|perimeter sensors]] and [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]] got badly damaged. He assumed that [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] and Tatooinian [[Scyk/Legends|lizards]] are responsible, sent money to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] to order a repairman, and waited at his farm.<ref name="Last One Out" />
{{GameLS}}
However, instead of a repairman, another individual came to his farm - an associate of a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Fauler]], hoping to ask Grommik a few questions about what happened years ago at the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|base]]. In exchange for information, they assisted Grommik in repairing his broken equipment. But just after the task was complete, [[Gayem Leksende]], a rogue Czerka operative, appeared via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], claiming responsibility for sabotaging the equipment to lure any potential interlopers to him. Gayem then sent his assassin droids to kill the occupants, and bombarded the farm from his airship. Grommik led the spacer to his safe room to survive the bombardment. With Gayem presuming they would asphyxiate to death, Grommik then revealed his hidden escape tunnel. He then provided the Fauler's associate with the locations of the data caches required to uncover the secret base, which he hid across the desert.<ref name="Last One Out" />
{{Endgame}}
